samples.question: The six tokens start in the shown left-to-right order, and the magenta ring marks one token. Read the five command cards from left to right. On each card, move every token matching the card's color to the arrow's edge. Matching tokens keep their relative order, and all other tokens keep their relative order. Which numbered slot contains the ringed token at the end? Answer 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, or 6.
